description: Complete the pending email change. Initial setup needs confirmation from the proposed mailbox. Replacement needs both confirmation from the new mailbox and previous_confirmation from the current mailbox in the same call. Removal needs previous_confirmation only. Codes expire in 24 hours and are invalidated by resend, cancellation, or editing the proposal.

confirmation.description: Code from the initial or replacement mailbox; not needed for removal.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

previous_confirmation.description: Approval code from the current verified mailbox; required for replacement or removal.

name: confirm_notifications
title: Confirm notifications
